newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Boliden to expand mining in Argentina.
newsitem.headline: Boliden to expand mining in Argentina.

text.p: Swedish minerals company Trelleborg's Boliden unit said on Monday it and Vancouver-listed Oro Belle Resources Corp planned to start mining operations for gold, copper and zinc in the Argentine province of Chubut.
The companies will start prospecting for metals, mostly gold, in the western part of the province, Boliden said in a statement.
The area is around 50,000 square kms and is seen as having large prospecting potential, the company said.
Boliden and Oro Belle will invest the same amount in the project, while Oro Belle will be responsible for operations.
Boliden will get a 60 percent ownership right to all base metal projects and one gold project. It will also operate these projects.
Oro Belle will operate and get a 60 percent ownership right to other gold projects, the company said.
"Argentina has today mining laws of international standards that promote the development of the mining industry," said Boliden chief executive Anders Bulow in a statement.
"Combined with the area's potential for copper and gold, it makes the project highly interesting. The cooperation with Oro Belle is a first step toward establishing us in an important area."
